title: Wallace and Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit': On the Set - Part 1
original_title: Wallace and Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit': On the Set - Part 1
overview: Part 1 of a two-part documentary on the Wallace & Gromit feature film, this segment takes a behind-the-scenes look at the history of Aardman Animation and the development of the Wallace and Gromit characters.
